taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4, continuously ascending resistivity curve)
Aquifer depth: 13.8 m – 97.9 m (Layer 3, resistive sand/gravel horizon)
Recommendation: Target the thick, highly resistive Layer 3 (13.8–97.9 m) as the primary aquifer zone for screen placement; drilling should proceed cautiously past 97.9 m to confirm whether the underlying high-resistivity Layer 4 represents a deeper water-bearing unit or competent bedrock before terminating the hole.
